svg.title: swapper architecture
svg.desc: Run java -jar swapper.jar to attach to a running JVM by PID (or use -javaagent). Inside the target JVM, App.agentmain plants a tiny DiagnosticBridge on the bootstrap classpath and starts an HTTP server on port 8000. The Web UI, the jbs-client TUI and AI agents call POST /mcp; McpDispatcher hands each tool call to Swapper, ClassTargetResolver picks the class by classLoaderHash, and an ASM or Javassist transformer is applied through Instrumentation.retransformClasses without a restart. Instrumented methods in any classloader call the bootstrap bridge, which forwards events to AgentDiagnosticListener and the Global log, streamed back over SSE /log and read_logs. delete or reset restores the original bytes, and watches auto-unload after maxHit hits.
svg.text: architecture ✦ hot-swap bytecode in a running JVM
① plants DiagnosticBridge on bootstrap CP
app classes · any classloader · all can see the bridge ↓
